node.title: Re^2: string replacement
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
my $pattern = join "|", map quotemeta, keys %replacements;

I think it would be good to also sort on length, as I discussed in [id://1179840]. Although [huck] does [id://1199209|make a good point] that preserving the original ordering may be important too. Update after your reply: Good point about replacements within the replacements, whether the OP wants that or not and which method is more appropriate will depend on their requirements.
